on 13 December, 2023
Author: Sudhir Kumar Jain

Bench: Sudhir Kumar Jain
 $~72
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
 + Crl.M.C. 9121/2023 & Crl.M.A. 34068/2023
 Rakesh Kumar Bhardwaj & Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Mukesh Yadav, Advo
 petitioners in person
 versus
 The State Nct Of Delhi & Anr.

Through: Mr. Pradeep Gahal
 State/R-1 with Si
 R-2 in person.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain
 Order

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 dated 25.04.2013 registered under sections 498A/354A/506/323/34 IPC at P.S. Nangloi along with consequential proceedings.
2. Issue notice.

3. Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Ruby,
P.S. Nangloi, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.1/State.
The respondent no. 2 is present in person and accepts notice.

4. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no.2 got married on 06.03.2003 at Delhi according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and out of their marriage, two children were born in the years 2004 and 2007, respectively.
Subsequently, matrimonial differences stated to be arisen between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2.

sentences.text: The respondent no. 2 filed petitions under section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2012 and under section 125 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner no. 1 also filed a divorce petition against the respondent no. 2.
It is stated that these petitions have already been disposed of/withdrawn by the concerned parties.

6. The respondent no. 2 also lodged a complaint before CAW Cell, Nangloi which culminated into registration of FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 under sections 498A/354A/506/323/34 IPC at P.S.
Nangloi.

After conclusion of investigation, the charge-sheet was filed under sections 406/498A/354A(1)/323/506/34 IPC wherein the petitioners were implicated, trial of which is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Sonam Singh, MM (Mahila Court), West District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi/Successor Court.

entities.text: MM (Mahila Court), West District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioners no. 2 and 3 are family members of the petitioner no.
1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 who appeared through video- conferencing are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Ruby, P.S. Nangloi.

7. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 due to intervention of elderly members of the family have settled their disputes orally and out of the settlement, they have agreed to live together happily at their matrimonial home with mutual love, affection and understanding.

8. The counsel for the petitioners stated that the since 2019, the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 are living together happily along with their children with mutual love, affection and understanding as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 be quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
9.
The respondent no. 2 stated that she has settled with the petitioner This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/12/2023 at 23:27:41 no.1 out of her own free will and without any force, fear or coercion and is living happily with the petitioner no. 1 in the matrimonial home as such, she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.
10.

The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated that under the given facts and circumstances, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings.

11. The petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 06.03.2003 and they have settled their disputes vide oral settlement and they are living together along with their children since 2019 with mutual love, affection and understanding.

No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of the present FIR are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.
After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0127/2013 dated 25.04.2013 registered under sections 498A/354A/506/323/34 IPC at P.S.
